name: ImageGrid
usage: Albums and galleries, grid views of assets or attachments, picking images

props.name: onOpen
props.description:
Opens an item on click or `Enter`, usually in FilePreview or Lightbox (with the same item IDs, the image flies
out of its tile and back).

props.name: overscan
props.description: Number of rows rendered outside the viewport (overscan), 3 by default.

props.name: onHover
props.description: Called when a tile is hovered or focused; use it to prefetch the full image or prepare drag data.

props.name: onTileDragStart
props.type: (index: number, item: ImageGridItem, event: DragEvent) => void
props.description: When set, tiles can be dragged; called in `dragstart` (set the drag data or start a custom drag here).

props.name: captionPlacement
props.description:
Position of the caption: `below` (default) under the tile; `overlay` on hover, as a gradient overlay at the
bottom of the image, which keeps the grid cleaner and the images more prominent (the overlay uses the neutral
viewer background tokens).

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: IDs of the selected tiles (shown with an accent selection ring).

types.name: ImageGridItem
types.summary: One tile of an ImageGrid: a thumbnail, or a fallback such as a file type icon for items without one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ID, used as the React key and in `selectedIds`.

fields.name: src
fields.description: URL of the thumbnail. Images are loaded lazily, when the tile is close to the viewport.

fields.name: alt
fields.description:
Alternative text of the image (such as its title); also the accessible name of the tile, which falls back to
`caption`.

fields.name: placeholderColor
fields.description:
Background color shown until the thumbnail has loaded, such as the average color from a ThumbHash, so that no
white tiles flash. Any CSS color.

fields.name: caption
fields.description:
Caption below the tile (or over the image on hover, with `captionPlacement="overlay"`), such as the file
name; long captions are truncated. Not shown when omitted.

fields.name: fallback
fields.description:
Content shown instead of the image when `src` is empty or the image fails to load, such as an icon or a file
type label. Without it, a failed image stays as it is.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Click an image to view it larger in a Lightbox; the height of the container comes from its parent.
